notes.title: Immersive Horror Update
notes.content:
A new building has been added.

Construction is now available in all locations.


Added more psychics and hidden locations.

notes.title: April 1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze.

Fixed an issue where the tracker would stop.

It made the production cost easier.

More components and materials if you scrap junk.

Longer duration of consumed items.

More elements have been added to the building.

ghosts, objects, places, etc.



More updates are coming.

thank you!
